body.name: Implementation-only pushforward interval decision family
body.construction: Implementation-only transformation with no theorem-level credit: for \(C\in\mathcal I_{n,m}\), define \(C^{(d)}(\mathsf S_d(O_1),\ldots,\mathsf S_d(O_n))=dC(O_1,\ldots,O_n)\), where multiplication by \(d\) scales both endpoints of both component intervals. Set \(\mathcal I^{(d)}_{n,m}=\{C^{(d)}:C\in\mathcal I_{n,m}\}\), \(R^{(d)}_{n,m}(C^{(d)},h)=\mathbb E_{(P^{(d)}_{m,h})^n}[\operatorname{length}_{\Sigma}(C^{(d)})]\), \(\ell^{(d)}_{n,m}(h)=\inf_{C^{(d)}\in\mathcal I^{(d)}_{n,m}}R^{(d)}_{n,m}(C^{(d)},h)\), and \(\mathfrak A^{(d)}_{n,m}=\inf_{C^{(d)}\in\mathcal I^{(d)}_{n,m}}\sup_{h\in H_m}R^{(d)}_{n,m}(C^{(d)},h)/\ell^{(d)}_{n,m}(h)\), where \(\operatorname{length}_{\Sigma}\) sums component lengths. By the definitions, \(C\mapsto C^{(d)}\) is a bijection onto the displayed image class, joint coverage is unchanged, \(R^{(d)}_{n,m}(C^{(d)},h)=dR_{n,m}(C,h)\), \(\ell^{(d)}_{n,m}(h)=d\ell_{n,m}(h)\), and \(\mathfrak A^{(d)}_{n,m}=\mathfrak A_{n,m}\).
